queue.body:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for the clear reply. I understand the current IEL cohort is already underway and that the next cycle is expected to open in September.

I would like to book a short fit call and ask one precise technical question: what would EPRI, IEL, or a participating utility need from LumenCore to scope a buyer-authorized field replay before or during the next cycle?

LumenCore is a hash-verified evidence/replay platform for infrastructure AI validation. The current strongest internal result is narrow: a Kuramoto phase-coupling candidate beat a named Kalman-filter baseline on 24 of 24 source-conditioned holdout checks, with about 2.5M estimated rows replayed in the champion core and 24 measured live-source systems in the latest public-safe provider probe. The broader 29-source registry is under refresh before broader public wording is reused.

Important boundary: I am not claiming field validation or realized savings. The goal is to run the next step correctly: utility-approved held-out data, incumbent baseline, acceptance metric, replay window, and economic conversion locked before scoring.

If useful, I can send a one-page replay protocol or walk through the live proof feed:
https://lumen-core.ai/mission_control.html
https://lumen-core.ai/data/champion_metric_gauntlet.json

Would your booking link be the right path for a fit call, or is there a better technical reviewer for AI/grid validation pilots?

Respectfully,
Robert Ashworth
LumenCore

suggested_fields.one_line: Hash-verified live-data replay and benchmark validation for infrastructure AI.
suggested_fields.problem: Infrastructure, energy, utility, and agency teams need credible ways to test AI and optimization claims before pilots or procurement. Today, many claims are hard to reproduce, disconnected from locked baselines, or not tied to buyer-approved acceptance metrics.
suggested_fields.solution: LumenCore ingests live and approved datasets, freezes provenance and hashes, runs locked baseline-vs-candidate replays, and publishes reviewer-safe proof feeds.
suggested_fields.traction: Live domain and reviewer feeds are deployed at lumen-core.ai. Current strongest internal result: Kuramoto phase coupling beat a named Kalman-filter baseline on 24/24 source-conditioned holdout checks, with about 2.5M estimated rows replayed in the champion core. The latest public-safe provider probe measures 24 live-source systems, with the broader 29-source registry under refresh before broader public wording is reused. LumenCore has submitted a DARPA DICE abstract and has received an Incubatenergy/EPRI response inviting a fit discussion for a future utility validation cycle.
suggested_fields.business_model: Paid evidence reviews, buyer-authorized field replay pilots, grant-funded validation packages, and annual platform licensing.
suggested_fields.use_of_funds: Field validation, data partnerships, security/compliance hardening, patent/legal support, pilot delivery, and conversion of the proof feed into a production-grade buyer portal.
suggested_fields.target_valuation_suggested: $10M post-money SAFE valuation cap, negotiable within an $8M-$12M band; if a pre-money valuation field is required, use $8M-$10M target pre-money.
suggested_fields.revenue_assumption: Pre-revenue / pilot-stage unless Robert confirms active paid revenue.
